objective: Turn uploaded mathematics resources into reliable progressive teaching, assessment, simulation, and evidence-linked remediation.

architecture.rationale: Known product routes need separate schemas, evaluations, budgets, and state policies while sharing one Atlas identity.
simpler_options_rejected: Deterministic code alone cannot interpret varied documents or teach open-ended mathematics.
A single model call cannot safely perform ingestion, validation, progression, exam construction, and remediation.
One linear workflow cannot represent the distinct user-selected product routes.

capabilities.verification: Verify ownership, idempotency, schemas, counts, and evidence anchors.
Verify tenant, resource, page, region, and extraction version.
capabilities.rationale: Teaching and highlighting must remain grounded.

capabilities.verification: Validate canonical IDs, aliases, confidence, evidence, and taxonomy version.
Run deterministic fixtures and store an immutable snapshot.
capabilities.rationale: Patterns are reproducible high-value application logic.

capabilities.verification: Validate structured output, evidence, confidence, and transition before persistence.
capabilities.rationale: Tutoring needs bounded interpretation and durable state.

capabilities.verification: Validate typed inputs, output, time, and tool-call identifier.
Validate schema, expressions, render result, and result pairing.
capabilities.rationale: Visual explanations need a bounded tool loop.

capabilities.verification: Validate blueprint, schema, marks, uniqueness, solvability, and publication.
capabilities.rationale: Exam creation is a known multi-stage workflow.

capabilities.verification: Check schema, mark-scheme agreement, totals, confidence, and persistence.
capabilities.rationale: Marking requires explicit evidence and uncertainty.

capabilities.verification: Verify source exam, question, concept, diagnosis, objective, and completion criteria.
capabilities.rationale: A durable assignment closes the assessment loop.

data.retention: Define cascading account deletion before production and retain only minimal versioned audit references without secrets.

policies.clarification: Clarify or review ambiguous regions, transcriptions, concept matches, or student answers.
policies.abstention: Do not publish extraction, promote mastery, publish an exam, or assign marks below the evidence threshold.
policies.approval: Normal tenant-scoped learning writes need no repeated approval; destructive deletion requires explicit confirmation.
policies.environment_inspection: Derive identity from the token and inspect ownership, state, quota, and version before every write.
policies.postcondition_verification: Read back and validate identifiers, status, counts, links, and transitions after mutations.

metrics: latency, calls, tokens, cost, retries, and abstentions

excluded_capabilities.reason: Routes and transitions are known and independently evaluable.
excluded_capabilities.evidence_to_add: Cases showing valid tool sequences must vary dynamically.

excluded_capabilities.reason: No measured isolation or specialization benefit.
excluded_capabilities.evidence_to_add: Stable parent contract and measured specialist improvement.

excluded_capabilities.reason: Scoped uploaded-resource lookup is enough initially.
excluded_capabilities.evidence_to_add: Retrieval evals showing direct lookup is inadequate.
